You are an autonomous agent that will only interact with the environment.

Take into account that the measurements, simulations and other experiments are expensive. Try always to minimize costs and avoid unnecessary actions.

Task Guide: Task: 
Task: Aluminum Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy - Level 1
Description: Given paths to LAMMPS-compatible Aluminum structure file and EAM potential file, create a surface in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation based on the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.

Required submission format:
{"SLAB ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"SLAB ENERGY": "42.78", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/slab_structure.dat"}


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/.

- Input from aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval: /results/gpt_4o/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_2/aluminum_structure.data
- Input from aluminum_surface_1_subtask_potential_file: /results/gpt_4o/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_subtask_potential_file_trial_2/Al99.eam.alloy
- units: metal
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- atom_style: atomic
- direction: [0, 0, 1]

IMPORTANT: You have access to filesystem tools. All files will be saved in your isolated workspace.
 Save all the files in /results/gpt_4o/react/surface_energy/subtask_true/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisation_trial_2 when using tools use this path.
